shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dipped below $60K, and Ethereum also fell, amid over $2 billion in liquidations.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $580 million in net outflows in a single day, with Ethereum ETFs also seeing significant withdrawals.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows "Extreme Fear" with scores ranging from 8 to 18, indicating strong negative sentiment.
Hawkish Federal Reserve expectations, persistent inflation concerns, and a broader tech sector sell-off continue to pressure crypto markets.
